description: Submit a brand-new software listing to Crela and start its review. Use this only for the FIRST submission of a tool that has never existed before. DO NOT use this to upload a newer version of a tool that already exists — use update_software for that. Always run precheck_build first to catch gate failures before wasting a review slot. entrypoint, framework, platforms, os and arch are auto-detected from the ZIP - pass them only when detection is wrong or the server reports an ambiguous entrypoint. Returns { tool: { id, slug, ... }, tool_review_id, build_id: null, warnings? }. Use tool.id as software_id for check_review_status, update_software, set_metadata and all other subsequent calls. The review starts asynchronously — poll check_review_status until complete. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

arch.description: CPU architecture; default x86_64; x64/amd64 and arm64 aliases accepted

description.description: Short description, min. 20 characters, no URLs

entrypoint.description: Path to the main binary inside the ZIP; auto-detected. Set it when the server reports the entrypoint is ambiguous (VALIDATION error with candidates).

file_path.description: Absolute path to the build ZIP on disk. Omit when passing storage_path.

framework.description: Override; auto-detected from the ZIP if omitted

long_description.description: Long description, min. 80 characters, no URLs

os.description: Target OS of this build; derived from the detected platforms if omitted

privacy_policy.description: Privacy policy text. Required in practice for anything with analytics or telemetry: KO_09 rejects a build whose code talks to a tracking service that the policy does not name.

storage_path.description: storage_path from a previous precheck_build response - reuses that upload instead of sending the same ZIP again.

support_contact.description: Support contact shown to buyers, e.g. an email address

tool_language.description: Language code of the software user interface, e.g. "de". NOT the programming language. Defaults to "de" - set it deliberately, it drives the lang filter in search_software.

version.description: Semver, e.g. "1.0.0". A first submission takes no pre-release suffix.

name: submit_new_software
title: Submit new software to Crela
